motion.name: running-status-pulse
motion.value: 3.1 radians per second; halo alpha ranges from 0.32 to 0.57
motion.purpose: A low-amplitude pulse marks active execution in the status badge only.

narrative.overview:
Neo AutoClicker uses a dark, modern control-station language for people configuring repeated clicks while another Windows app is in front. The visual system is calm and information-first: graphite surfaces carry the controls, a measured teal identifies active actions, and amber or red is reserved for status and warnings.

The interface gives execution and its stop action a fixed home in the left rail. The main area holds destination, repetition, points, and their shortcuts. A single soft pulse on the running status supplies the technological note; the rest of the surface stays still and readable.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite surfaces with teal control highlights.
Persistent execution controls and visible shortcut chords.
Thin borders and tonal layering instead of drop shadows.
One restrained status animation while clicks are running.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal marks selection and activity; amber and red retain warning and stop meaning.

dos: Keep the primary start and emergency stop actions easy to locate.
Keep a shortcut's full chord visible in its chip.
Use amber for timing warnings and red for stop or failure feedback.
Keep actions operable by keyboard and pointer.
donts: Don't add a separate speed-mode selector; retain the destination and repetition choices.
Don't use glow, grids, or animation as background decoration.
Don't describe requested CPS as guaranteed or as clicks acknowledged by another app.

components.name: Start Button
components.description: Full-width primary action for starting a run.
components.css: .ds-start { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #1D7E77; border-radius: 7px; background: #1D7E77; color: #E7EFF2; font: 700 16px/1.2 sans-serif; } .ds-start:hover { background: #236F6B; } .ds-start:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4FD8CA; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-start:active { background: #185E5A; }

components.name: Emergency Stop
components.description: Red-tinted stop action next to the current execution state.
components.css: .ds-stop { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #8B424A; border-radius: 7px; background: #5E272F; color: #E7EFF2; font: 600 13px/1.2 sans-serif; } .ds-stop:hover { background: #75323A; } .ds-stop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #EF676F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Shortcut Chip
components.description: Shows the saved chord and becomes a live listening preview when selected.
components.css: .ds-shortcut { min-height: 34px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #2E3E48; border-radius: 7px; background: #1D2830; color: #E7EFF2; font: 600 13px/1.2 sans-serif; } .ds-shortcut:hover, .ds-shortcut:focus-visible { border-color: #4FD8CA; outline: none; } .ds-shortcut[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #1D7E77; background: #153638; color: #4FD8CA; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Dark raised field for profile names and coordinates.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 34px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid #2E3E48; border-radius: 7px; background: #1D2830; color: #E7EFF2; font: 400 14px/1.3 sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #4FD8CA; outline: 2px solid #4FD8CA; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Destination Tab
components.description: Mutually exclusive cursor, fixed-point, and sequence choice.
components.css: .ds-tab { min-height: 34px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #2E3E48; border-radius: 7px; background: #1D2830; color: #E7EFF2; font: 600 13px/1.2 sans-serif; } .ds-tab:hover { border-color: #4FD8CA; } .ds-tab-active { border-color: #1D7E77; background: #143435; color: #4FD8CA; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4FD8CA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface Panel
components.description: Tonal container for a major configuration area.
components.html:
Destino e repetição

Escolha onde os cliques acontecem.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid #2E3E48; border-radius: 10px; background: #151D24; color: #E7EFF2; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 9px; font: 700 17px/1.25 sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #91A3AC; font: 400 14px/1.4 sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact run state; only active execution carries a soft pulse.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid #2E3E48; border-radius: 18px; background: #1D2830; color: #91A3AC; font: 600 12px/1.2 sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-active { border-color: #1D7E77; background: #143435; color: #4FD8CA; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-status-active .ds-status-dot { animation: ds-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #4FD8CA33; } }
